## What you need

- **Must (headline):** Kubernetes, Terraform / IaC, Git & CI/CD, Docker, Python (production), AWS / Azure / GCP, Observability (OpenTelemetry traces, metrics).
- **Important (headline):** Linux, KServe / Ray Serve, LLM gateways, OAuth/OIDC, RBAC, SSO, MLOps lifecycle (model & prompt CI/CD), Model supply chain & CVEs, SRE (SLOs, on-call, incidents), vLLM / SGLang / TensorRT-LLM.
- **Full inventory:** 77 skills (Must 7 · Important 15 · Should 34 · Optional 21), each with its evidence and posting keywords: [ml-platform-engineer.md](../../03-skills-and-tech/inventories/ml-platform-engineer.md).
- **Prerequisites:** Backend, DevOps or SRE background; India GCCs use the MLOps Engineer title (Taggd, C)
- **Credentials (tie-breakers, not skills):** Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) (Optional: not in the corpus; common in platform hiring); AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01) (Optional: MLOps-oriented associate credential). Whether one is worth it: [credential ROI](../../04-certifications/credential-roi.md).
- What to learn first and what to drop across roles: [skills radar](../../03-skills-and-tech/skills-radar.md); in what order: [learning roadmaps](../../03-skills-and-tech/learning-roadmaps.md).

## How to prove it

- **What the evidence asks for:** A self-hosted vLLM/SGLang cluster with continuous synthetic load benchmarks, automated failover, dynamic LoRA routing and Grafana dashboards
- **Project archetypes that cover the most of its Must and Important skills** (Grade M): [P6 Self-hosted LLM platform on Kubernetes](../../05-portfolio/project-archetypes.md#p6) (92%); [P1 Evaluated RAG system over a real corpus](../../05-portfolio/project-archetypes.md#p1) (32%); [P15 Internal AI-enablement pilot (MCP servers, adoption metrics)](../../05-portfolio/project-archetypes.md#p15) (19%). One project rarely covers a role; [job-search strategy §2.6](../../06-job-search/job-search-strategy.md#26-the-constraints-that-bind-first) computes the smallest sets that do.
- How verifiable the proof must be, and what to publish: [proof-of-work standards](../../05-portfolio/proof-of-work-standards.md).

## How you are interviewed

- **Track: Infrastructure.** It tests KV-cache maths, decode roofline, continuous batching, prefill/decode disaggregation, GPU scheduling, p95 debugging. Source: career/02-roles/role-catalog.md §8.2 (T1-03, T0-14).
- **Practise:** the [infrastructure prep pack](../../08-interviewing/prep-packs.md#infrastructure-pack), plus the behavioural and coding packs.
- Classify the loop first, then prepare by round: [interview loops](../../08-interviewing/interview-loops.md).

## Résumé

- **Variant:** D2 (AI Systems & Infrastructure). Headline pattern: "Inference / AI Infrastructure Engineer | serving, GPUs, Kubernetes".
- **Keywords to mirror, only when true:** MLOps, LLMOps, Kubernetes (69.4% of DevOps postings), Terraform (59.1%), CI/CD (81.2%), model serving, KServe, monitoring
- **Leave out or reframe:** Generic DevOps bullets with no model-serving scope
